The latest Iranian response came after US attacks on Tuesday and Sunday, including a strike that the Iranian Red Crescent said killed four people, including a child, and wounded more than 50 others during a wedding celebration in the city of Kuhestak. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said early Wednesday that US Marine Corps base Camp Titin in Jordan had come under an “intense ballistic missile attack”, according to Iranian news outlet Tasnim. The Jordanian army said its air defence systems intercepted 10 ballistic missiles launched from Iran. It did not report any injuries or confirm that the US training camp, located on the Gulf of Aqaba near the borders with Israel and Saudi Arabia, had been hit. Three additional missiles landed in remote areas, the army said. Iranian missile and drone activity was also reported in Kuwait, where the army said it was responding to Iranian hostilities.
